_meta.note: 12 most common Part 1 topics in IELTS Speaking. Each topic has 5 typical question prompts the examiner might ask in a 4-5 minute Part 1 conversation.

topics.label: Work or studies
questions: Do you work, or are you a student?
What do you enjoy most about your job (or studies)?
Is there anything you would like to change about your work or studies?
What did you want to be when you were a child?
Do you think you will be doing the same job in five years?

topics.label: Hometown
questions: Where is your hometown?
What do you like most about it?
Has it changed much since you were a child?
Would you recommend it to a tourist?
Do you think you will live there in the future?

topics.label: Home and accommodation
questions: Do you live in a house or an apartment?
What is your favourite room in your home?
Is there anything you would change about your home?
Do you prefer living alone or with other people?
Would you like to live somewhere different in the future?

topics.label: Hobbies and free time
questions: What do you usually do in your free time?
Did you have the same hobbies when you were a child?
Do you prefer indoor or outdoor activities?
How much free time do you have each week?
Are hobbies important? Why?

topics.label: Food and cooking
questions: What kind of food do you usually eat?
Do you enjoy cooking?
What is a typical dish from your country?
Do you prefer eating at home or in restaurants?
Have your eating habits changed in recent years?

topics.label: Travel and holidays
questions: Do you enjoy travelling?
What kind of places do you like to visit?
Do you prefer travelling alone or with others?
Have you ever travelled abroad?
What is the best holiday you have ever had?

topics.label: Music
questions: What kind of music do you listen to?
Has your taste in music changed over the years?
Do you play a musical instrument?
When do you usually listen to music?
Do you ever go to concerts?

topics.label: Reading
questions: Do you like reading?
What kind of books do you usually read?
Do you prefer paper books or digital books?
How much time do you spend reading each week?
Did you enjoy reading as a child?

topics.label: Technology and the internet
questions: How often do you use the internet?
What kind of websites or apps do you use most?
Has technology made your life easier or more complicated?
Do you think children spend too much time on devices?
Could you imagine living without the internet?

topics.label: Weather and seasons
questions: What is the weather usually like in your hometown?
Which season do you prefer and why?
Does the weather affect your mood?
Do you check the weather forecast often?
Has the weather in your country changed in recent years?

topics.label: Shopping
questions: Do you enjoy shopping?
What do you usually shop for?
Do you prefer shopping online or in shops?
How often do you go shopping for clothes?
Have your shopping habits changed in recent years?

topics.label: Friends
questions: Do you have many close friends?
How often do you see your friends?
What kind of activities do you do with your friends?
Is it easy to make new friends as an adult?
How important is it to keep in touch with old friends?
